svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 240 x 40 mm from 2 mm sheet; round the corners and deburr.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four 5.5 mm holes on the centre line, 15, 45, 195 and 225 from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: left end. Drill it clamped under the lid so the holes match.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: under the lid, centred, held by the four M5 handle bolts;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the nyloc nuts sit on the doubler.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: It spreads the carrying load of about 9.4 kg over the thin lid.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the bolts pass through handle, lid and doubler without forcing.
